LanguageData.CC_R2_Lost_Cold: {PAWN_nameDef} was out in the cold too long and has {ILLNESS}.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LostSearch: Two or three of the colony go out with lights toward where {0} was last seen, find them and walk home together
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LostLight: {0} stands at the edge of the colony with a light and a horn until {1} walks in toward it
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LostMorning: {0} waits out the night where they are and walks home at first light
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LostCold: Out in the frost, {0} may get frostnip or chilblains
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_PutBy: A bill for {0} pemmican at the {1}, so the catch keeps
LanguageData.CC_R2_Fish_PutBy: A bill for {0} pemmican has been set at the {1}, to put the fish by for the winter.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_WallDen: The {0} left to sleep in the hollow, and a wall of {1} marked across the gap; in the first warm days the wall is taken down and the bear walks off the land
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_WallDenBrief: the bear walled in until spring
LanguageData.CC_R2_Den_TakeDown: It's warm enough now: the wall across the bear's hollow is marked to be taken down, so the {BEAR} can walk out.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Den_WalksOut: The {BEAR} that slept the winter in the hollow has woken and is walking off the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Water_OneField: The colony has only one field to give water to
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_WaterChain: At dawn, everyone free carries water from the nearest water to the field for {0} hours, and the field grows that day as it would have in rain
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LetGo: The crop in the {0} marked to be cut and brought in, and the other fields get half a day's growth
LanguageData.CC_R2_Water_LetGo: The {0} is let go: {1} plants are marked to be cut, and its water goes to the other fields.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Water_Done: The water chain is over: {1} loads of water were carried to the {0}, and it has had what it needs today.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_KeepIn: The colony's animals brought into the pens, and the children kept near the middle of the colony until the {0} has wandered off
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_KeepInBrief: the herd in and the children kept close
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Mad_hunt: If the hunters miss it, the {0} may go mad later today and attack whoever is nearest
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Mad_let: The {0} may go mad later today and attack whoever is nearest
LanguageData.CC_R2_Wrong_Mad: The {X} that was acting wrong at the edge of the colony has gone mad and is attacking.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Wrong_Gone: The {X} that was acting wrong has wandered off the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Hid_NoBed: There is no free prison bed
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Hid_take: {1} goes out to arrest {0} and bring them to a prison bed, with {2} beside them
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Hid_feed: Once the food has reached {0}, they set off home
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Hid_drive: {2} walks out toward {0} with a weapon raised and shouts, and {0} runs off the land
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_HidFight: {0} may fight rather than be taken, as the game has it
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Rope: {0} and {1} pull the {2} out with a rope, about an hour's work, and come back muddy
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Boards: {0} lays boards out across the mud to the {1} and leads it out
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_BogLeave: The {0} left to free itself if it can
LanguageData.CC_R2_Bog_Self: The {X} has worked itself free of the mud.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Bog_Rope: The {X} has been pulled out of the mud.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Bog_Boards: The boards reached the {X}, and it has been led out of the mud.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Air_NoShaft: There's no open sky within {0} cells of rock
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Air_shaft: The rock between the face and the nearest open sky marked for digging, and the face left until the air clears
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Air_turns: The digging at the face marked again; anyone in the bad air too long is sent out to breathe
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Air_wall: A wall marked across the way in, and that face left
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_AirRisk: Whoever works in the bad air breathes some of it: the gas's own poisoning, mild if the turns are short
LanguageData.CC_R2_Air_Clear: The bad air in the deep dig has cleared.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Room_Taken: Someone sleeps in the room already
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Room_clear: {1}'s bed taken up and carried to the stores, and the room the colony's to use
LanguageData.CC_R2_Room_Cleared: {DEAD}'s bed is marked to be taken up and carried to the stores.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Lay_NoPlace: The colony has nowhere to do it that way now
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Lay_fire: A bill at the crematorium to cremate {0}
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Lay_whole: An empty sarcophagus given to {0}, who is laid in it whole
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Lay_soil: An empty grave given to {0}, in the ground
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Lay_custom: {0} buried as the colony buries its own
LanguageData.CC_R2_Lay_Fire: A bill has been set at the {PLACE} to cremate {DEAD}.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_OrdealStone: At the hearth at dusk, before the colony, {0} and {1} each carry a hot stone across it
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_OrdealOath: At the furnace at dusk, before the colony, {0} and {1} each swear with a hand on its housing
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_OrdealBurn: {0} or {1}, or both, may be burned across the hands
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_Burned: {B_nameDef} and {C_nameDef} carried the hot stone across the hearth before the colony. {TRUE_nameDef} came through it less burned, and those who hold to the hearth take {TRUE_objective} for the one who told the truth.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_Clean: {B_nameDef} and {C_nameDef} carried the hot stone across the hearth before the colony, and neither was burned. Those who hold to the hearth still take {TRUE_nameDef} for the one who told the truth.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_Oath: {B_nameDef} and {C_nameDef} swore before the colony with a hand on the furnace's housing. Those who hold to the hearth believe {TRUE_nameDef}, and will be watching {OTHER_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_Burn: {PAWN_nameDef} has a burn across the hands.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_Belief: The hearth spared {TRUE} and burned {OTHER}, and so {TRUE} told the truth.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Ordeal_BeliefOath: {TRUE} swore at the furnace and spoke true; if ill luck comes to {OTHER}, it will be the deep's answer.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_LateFeast: {FESTIVAL} let pass tomorrow, and held at the table once the mourning days are past
LanguageData.CC_R2_LateFeast: The mourning days for {DEAD} are past, and {FESTIVAL} is to be kept at the table this evening.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Tales: {0} tells {1} one of the tales of the gods as they go
LanguageData.CC_R2_Why_Pardon: asked pardon before the work the god won't have
LanguageData.CC_R2_Why_Made: made to do the work the god won't have
LanguageData.CC_R2_Camp_NoGrave: The colony has no empty grave and no room to dig one
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Camp_grave: An empty grave of the colony's given to {0}, or one marked out to be dug
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Camp_graveBrief: a grave in the colony's ground
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Camp_home: One of the camp carries {0} away, and the camp leaves early with them
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_Camp_own: One of the camp carries {0} off the land
LanguageData.CC_R2_Camp_Grave: The {PLACE} has been given to {DEAD} of the camp.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Camp_GraveDug: A grave is marked out for {DEAD} of the camp, near the colony's own.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Camp_Carried_home: {PAWN_nameDef} is carrying {DEAD} away, and the camp is packing up to go home.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Camp_Carried_own: {PAWN_nameDef} is carrying {DEAD} away off the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_R2_Impact_AgeDay: "{0}" put on the colony's calendar, kept each year from now on
